name: Web Plura Catalog Auditor – Product Data & Listing Readiness
author: Web Plura

sections.description:
Published WooCommerce products are not always ready for shopping feeds, product discovery, marketplace review, or AI-assisted product context. Missing images, weak titles, thin descriptions, duplicate SKUs, broken prices, variation gaps, missing identifiers, and trust-policy issues can create avoidable cleanup before product feed or catalog work.

Web Plura Catalog Readiness Auditor is a WooCommerce product data audit plugin for store owners and agencies who need to find catalog readiness issues before working on Google Shopping, Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Bing, or product feed submissions.

Use the free local audit to review products for missing titles, weak descriptions, image gaps, price issues, SKU problems, stock status, product URLs, shipping details, variation gaps, schema hints, trust-policy signals, and common feed-readiness blockers. It helps you fix product data quality before catalog rejection, poor listing quality, or missing product context creates avoidable work.

The free plugin is local-first, WooCommerce-only, and useful without an external service account.

WooCommerce catalog problems it helps review

Catalog Readiness Auditor is built for product-data checks such as:

  • Missing WooCommerce product images, titles, descriptions, prices, categories, URLs, SKUs, and stock status.
  • Duplicate titles, duplicate descriptions, duplicate SKUs, variation gaps, and downloadable-product setup issues.
  • Locally detectable GTIN, MPN, brand, condition, category mapping, and apparel-style attribute readiness.
  • Product schema hints, trust-policy signals, media quality, and technical discoverability.
  • Channel-readiness views for Google, Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and Bing using local WooCommerce product data only.

Free version features

  • Local WooCommerce product catalog-readiness audits from the WordPress dashboard.
  • Bounded scan controls for starting, resuming, cancelling, resetting, and reviewing local product audits.
  • Checks for missing or weak titles, descriptions, images, prices, categories, product URLs, SKUs, stock status, shipping details, downloadable-file setup, variation gaps, and sale-price setup where locally detectable.
  • Identifier and product-data checks for locally available GTIN, MPN, brand, condition, duplicate titles, duplicate descriptions, duplicate SKUs, category mapping readiness, and apparel-style product attributes.
  • Channel-readiness views for Google, Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and Bing based on local WooCommerce product data only.
  • Fix First grouping for price, image, visibility, identifier, category, variation, schema, and trust-policy blockers.
  • Local compatibility detection for common catalog/feed/schema tools installed on the WordPress site. The plugin does not call those tools or external catalog APIs.
  • Visibility, technical discoverability, media quality, trust-policy, product data, shopping-feed readiness, and AI product discovery readiness scores.
  • Product issue review, severity grouping, channel and product-type filters, filtered issue CSV exports, product readiness summaries, local audit history, and printable summaries for client or internal review.
  • Local settings for consent, scan limits, retention, image thresholds, ignored products, and ignored issue types.
  • No external account requirement, no automatic external service requests, and no product report data transmission from the free plugin.

The plugin does not generate, publish, sync, or submit product feed files. It focuses on WooCommerce product data readiness checks and issue review before you use a feed manager, merchant center, marketplace, or advertising channel.

This free plugin keeps audits, history, exports, and consent controls local to WordPress. Scores and findings are deterministic local estimates and do not guarantee commerce platform approval, search placement, advertising performance, AI answer inclusion, or product ranking.

Good Fit For

  • WooCommerce stores preparing products for shopping channels or feed tools.
  • Agencies auditing product data before a catalog, SEO, or advertising handoff.
  • Store managers looking for missing images, duplicate SKUs, weak descriptions, variation gaps, or identifier issues.
  • Teams that need CSV exports and printable product-readiness summaries before fixing catalog data.

Product page: https://wplura.com/products/web-plura-catalog-readiness-auditor
Terms: https://wplura.com/terms
Privacy: https://wplura.com/privacy

External Services

This free plugin does not make automatic external service requests and does not transmit product report data externally.

The product, terms, privacy, and compare-plan links in the plugin and readme are user-clicked links only. Opening those links takes the user to Web Plura pages in a browser; no local product audit data, product report data, product scores, scan history, or product issue details are sent by the free plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen or upload the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Activate Catalog Readiness Auditor from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Catalog Readiness Auditor in the WordPress dashboard.
  4. Accept local processing consent.
  5. Run your first local audit from the Dashboard.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a paid account?

No. Free local audits work after local consent is accepted.

Does the plugin generate product feeds?

No. This initial release audits WooCommerce product visibility, catalog readiness, and local product data quality. It does not generate product feed files.

Can it help before Google Shopping or Merchant Center work?

Yes. The local audit can help review product-data gaps such as images, titles, descriptions, prices, identifiers, categories, URLs, stock, variations, schema hints, and trust-policy signals before a feed manager or merchant workflow. It does not submit products or guarantee approval.

Can it find duplicate SKUs, missing images, and weak descriptions?

Yes. The free audit can flag duplicate SKU signals, image gaps, weak or missing descriptions, missing or weak titles, price issues, variation gaps, and other locally detectable catalog data problems.

Which ecommerce platforms are supported?

The free plugin supports WooCommerce product audits only. Separate Web Plura services can support additional commerce platforms such as Easy Digital Downloads and SureCart where available.

What data is sent externally?

The free plugin does not transmit product report data externally.

Do scores guarantee approval, ranking, or AI inclusion?

No. Scores are local readiness estimates for review and prioritization. They do not guarantee commerce platform approval, search placement, advertising performance, AI answer inclusion, or product ranking.

Does the plugin handle purchase or payment checkout inside WordPress?

No. It only audits locally visible WooCommerce product catalog readiness data and does not process purchases or payments.

Is this a WooCommerce product feed plugin?

No. It is a product data audit and catalog-readiness plugin. Use it before a feed manager, merchant center, marketplace, or advertising channel workflow.

Can it help find missing WooCommerce product images, SKUs, and descriptions?

Yes. The local audit can flag image gaps, SKU issues, weak descriptions, missing titles, price issues, variation gaps, and other locally detectable catalog data problems.

Does it call Google, Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Bing, or catalog APIs?

No. Channel-readiness views use local WooCommerce product data only. The free plugin does not call external catalog APIs or transmit product report data.
sections.changelog:
0.1.6

  • Refreshed the WordPress.org readme for clearer WooCommerce catalog audit, product readiness, image, price, stock, and variation search intent.

0.1.5

  • Promoted canonical Web Plura Catalog Readiness Auditor constants while preserving legacy PLURA_MFA_* aliases.

0.1.4

  • Added a reversible dashboard audit workflow extension surface so Pro can replace eligible cloud-connected catalog monitoring content while the local Free audit fallback remains available.

0.1.2

  • Updated the public package display name for WordPress.org review-safe catalog readiness positioning.

0.1.1

  • Added first-run local processing consent and setup readiness guidance before local audit actions.
  • Added recent scan history, variation readiness checks, improved issue filters, and clearer product/catalog readiness guidance.
  • Added canonical Web Plura extension hooks while preserving compatibility hooks for add-ons.

0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added WordPress-native local product visibility and catalog readiness audits for WooCommerce.
  • Added bounded local history, filtered issue CSV export, product readiness CSV export, printable summary, local scoring, and local consent controls.
